The following RPC handler methods can transitively cause an outbound HTTP request to a user-configured webhook URL:

1. **`CreateMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` — calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at line 157
2. **`UpdateMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` — calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at line 513, which calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
3. **`DeleteMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` — calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at line 562
4. **`CreateMemoComment`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` — calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at line 119

All four paths converge on the single function **`webhook.PostAsync`** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which enqueues the payload for asynchronous delivery. The async workers then call **`Post`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) to perform the actual outbound HTTP request.
